name: mcp
title: MCP and API keys
summary: Users create personal API keys so their agents can call the app's tools over MCP as them.

env.name: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE
env.doc: MCP requests allowed per API key per minute.

stitch: Make sure each feature agents should use implements app.ToolProvider with prescriptive descriptions; write tools are offered only to keys with the write scope.
Rewrite the server instructions and card description in backend/internal/mcp/mcp.go for this app.
Expose the API's /mcp and /.well-known/mcp.json on a public URL agents can reach (PUBLIC_API_URL is what the server card advertises).
